summary: KYC bug fix validated - 'Übermittlung fehlgeschlagen' error no longer blocks successful submissions. Fresh accounts can complete full KYC flow. Users with pending KYC are correctly redirected to status page instead of generic error.
critical_code_review_comments: KYCFlow.jsx correctly handles already-submitted error by calling loadStatus() and redirecting to status page
kycUpload.js isAlreadySubmittedKycError() correctly detects 'bereits eingereicht' and 'warte auf prüfung' messages
Backend kyc.py correctly validates HEIC/HEIF formats via extension when mime type is application/octet-stream
Backend returns structured error messages instead of generic 'Übermittlung fehlgeschlagen'
seed_data_creation: Created multiple test accounts for KYC testing: kyc.test.*, kyc.heic.*, kyc.playwright.*
context_for_next_testing_agent: KYC flow fix validated. Key findings: (1) Fresh users can complete full KYC flow without 'Übermittlung fehlgeschlagen' error, (2) Users with pending KYC are redirected to status page showing 'In Prüfung', (3) HEIC/HEIF formats accepted via extension validation, (4) Invalid file types correctly rejected. Test accounts created during testing have pending KYC status.
rca_of_the_issue: Original issue was generic 'Übermittlung fehlgeschlagen' error blocking KYC submissions. Fix involved: (1) Better error message parsing in KYCFlow.jsx to extract specific error details, (2) isAlreadySubmittedKycError() helper to detect already-pending state and redirect to status page, (3) Backend validation accepting HEIC/HEIF via extension when mime type is octet-stream (common for mobile uploads).
